_comment: Provisional M0 deck (GDD §5.1 [AMD], docs/M0_PLAN.md D1). Not a design commitment: whatever survives the M0 gate is promoted into the GDD as the real skill table. Weight and Recovery are inherited from the class table in GDD §4.1 — a card never states them itself. M0 has three axes and no more: Weight class, damage, and reach. Tags are inert until the Weave lands in M1, so two cards sharing a class and a reach differ only in damage and the smaller one is never worth playing. The catalogue therefore holds one card per (class, reach) and the deck below repeats them.
_deckComment: Twelve cards, and the same Weight curve the twelve-distinct deck had: five Light, four Standard, two Heavy, one Ultimate. Repeats rather than near-duplicates — a second Lunge is another Lunge, which is honest, where a Strike was a Lunge you would never choose.
